record.title: Finland restricts entry of Russian-registered passenger vehicles, September 2023
record.scope: Finnish external-EU import controls at the eastern and Norwegian frontiers; a nationality rule or whole-country perimeter closure is not inferred.
record.crossings: Russian–Finnish and Norwegian–Finnish land-border posts; individual coordinates not reviewed
record.movement: Non-exempt Russian-registered vehicles principally under commodity code 8703, including passenger cars, camper vans and small minibuses
record.exceptions: Specified EU/EEA citizens permanently resident in Russia, including dual citizens, and their family members are excepted, as are diplomatic vehicles and vehicles used for humanitarian entry. Individual admission requirements remain separate.
record.imposing_authority: Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs and Customs
record.enforcement: Official ministry announcement and Tulli’s prospective enforcement instructions are recovered, without a first observed refusal.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified in this round.
record.relationship: EU037 concerns people’s non-essential travel. EU001/EU002 concern later road-post suspensions. The vehicle-import regime starts earlier and also expressly includes the Norwegian frontier.
record.status_observation: Historical source evidence only. Unknown endpoint does not establish the present status of the border.
record.current_timing: Formal policy: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: Both the Russian and Norwegian external-EU land frontiers are expressly within scope. The existing-car removal deadline is not reopening, and later physical road-post closures must remain separate.
record.rationale_coding_status: Source-attributed coding accepted after separate challenge; qualifications retained
record.rationale_phase_note: Codes describe the attributed purposes of the specified restriction, not all policies at the same border.

followup_reviews.Research finding: The September 2023 Finnish vehicle-import rule remains included and distinct from personal-entry restrictions and subsequent physical post closures. Retain principally code-8703 Russian-registered passenger vehicles and the specified EU/EEA residence/family, humanitarian and diplomatic exceptions. The rule explicitly covers Norway–Finland as well as Russia–Finland external-EU frontiers. P1 retains formal onset at 00:00 on 16 September 2023 with no established endpoint or numerical operational duration. The six-month removal deadline for already-present cars is not reopening. Retain the official EU-sanctions implementation and uniform-enforcement rationale; no belief or conduct of individual car owners is inferred. The Tulli-authored release was freshly read through its distributor; ministry text was reread from cache. STTinfo and the same authority’s release are not distinct reporting origins. The policy remains unlocated with no post coordinates or whole-country outline. The Norwegian frontier is preserved as explicit scope, not treated as a new geometry assumption.
